name: quorum-site
description: quorum.watch static landing page. Railway: set the service root directory to site/ and run npm start. The one built part is app-preview/, the app shown on the home page: npm run preview builds it from ../app/site-preview, and npm run deploy runs that first.

scripts.deploy: npm run -s preview && npm run -s stamp && railway up --service site --detach --no-gitignore
